folder_purpose: OKF Model Reference & 66degrees Blog Content Writing Guidelines

brand_identity.core_value_proposition: Premier Google Cloud Partner delivering end-to-end cloud transformation, data engineering, modern analytics, and generative AI solutions.
brand_identity.brand_voice: Authoritative, insightful, technical yet accessible, solution-oriented, and forward-thinking.

target_audience: Chief Technology Officers (CTOs) & Chief Information Officers (CIOs)
VP of Data / Chief Data Officers (CDOs)
IT Directors, Cloud Architects, and Enterprise Infrastructure Leaders
Business Leadership seeking Digital Transformation on Google Cloud
core_content_pillars: Generative AI & Machine Learning Implementation (Vertex AI)
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Ecosystem Trends & Best Practices

title.formatting_rules: Actionable, clear, incorporating primary keyword naturally. Avoid clickbait.
examples: How to Modernize Enterprise Data Platforms Using Google BigQuery
A Practical Guide to Enterprise Generative AI on Vertex AI

meta_description.formatting_rules: Summarize the key takeaway, include primary keyword, and provide a clear reason to read.

article_structure.introduction: Hook the reader in the first 2-3 sentences. Define the enterprise pain point clearly, state why solving it matters, and outline what the article covers.
article_structure.body_headings: Use H2s for main sections, H3s for sub-topics. Keep headers descriptive and SEO-friendly.
formatting_elements: Short paragraphs (2-4 sentences max) for readability.
Bullet points and numbered lists for steps and takeaways.
Bold text for key concepts and metrics.
Diagrams, architecture flowcharts, or code blocks for technical depth.
article_structure.conclusion: Summarize the key takeaways and tie back to business impact. Include a strategic Call-to-Action (CTA).

call_to_action_cta.placement: End of blog post, with optional mid-post contextual link.
examples: Ready to accelerate your cloud migration? Speak with a 66degrees Google Cloud expert today.
Download our full guide on modernizing data architecture with Google Cloud.

seo_and_content_standards.keyword_usage: Integrate primary keyword in Title, H1, Meta Description, first 100 words, and naturally 2-3 times throughout the body (1-2% density).
seo_and_content_standards.internal_linking: Link to at least 2-3 relevant 66degrees case studies, service pages, or related blog posts.
seo_and_content_standards.external_linking: Link to official Google Cloud documentation or recognized industry benchmarks when citing data.
tone_and_style: Use active voice (aim for >85% active voice).
Avoid fluff, overly academic jargon, or empty marketing buzzwords.
Provide concrete examples, ROI considerations, and real-world implementation nuances.

dos: Ground claims in real enterprise scenarios and Google Cloud capabilities.
Provide actionable advice that technical leaders can implement.
Highlight 66degrees' expertise as a trusted Google Cloud Premier Partner.
Include visual breakups like architecture diagrams or callout boxes.
donts: Don't write purely promotional content without providing educational value.
Don't use outdated GCP terminology or deprecated features.
Don't copy content or rehash generic surface-level advice.
